title: Farming begins in New Guinea
place: Kuk Swamp, Western Highlands, Papua New Guinea
summary: Drainage ditches at Kuk Swamp show early farming. UNESCO lists it as a place where people independently developed agriculture.
why: Proof that farming was invented separately in several parts of the world.
interchange: Farming also invented in the Fertile Crescent, China, Mesoamerica, the Andes and Africa
